entities.name: Cim
entities.description: The eldest of three dryad sisters of the Selesnya Conclave, a small, slight dryad who bridges her sisters and who becomes the voice of the new guildmaster.

entities.name: Oba
entities.description: A wild, lively dryad sister of Cim and Ses.

entities.name: Ses
entities.description: An orderly dryad sister of Cim and Oba.

entities.name: Suniel
entities.description: A bearded Selesnya woodshaper who shapes living trees into his home and helps the dryads reach the Lattice.

entities.name: Mat'Selesnya
entities.description: The ancient parun of the Selesnya Conclave, trapped in or lost within the Lattice, whom the dryads seek to reach.

entities.name: Molander
entities.description: A haggard elf priest of Selesnya who wants to teach the guild's precepts at an academy to keep the guild alive.

entities.name: Troslon
entities.description: A Selesnya high priest with boulder-like fists who opposes rules and academies.

entities.name: Alcarus
entities.description: A Selesnya high priest who reminds the council of Rakdos's fate.

entities.name: Sadruna
entities.description: A Selesnya high priest who rejects comparisons to the Rakdos.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: The nature-and-community guild of Ravnica, fracturing as its parun is lost.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane where the guilds of Ravnica are in disarray.

entities.name: Worldsoul
entities.description: The empathic energy that connects all Selesnya.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: The World Tree of Selesnya, site of the Conclave's great hall, which was attacked.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: The demon of the Cult of Rakdos, said to have been dragged through the streets and thrown into a hellpit, fate unknown.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: The guild of rules and law, mentioned as the place for those who want rules and academies.

entities.name: Gruul
entities.description: A guild whose rubble-dwelling ways Molander mocks.

events.summary: Three dryad sisters, Cim, Oba and Ses, try to make contact with Mat'Selesnya in a trance and report that she is in a giant web but cannot be reached.
events.quote: She's there in that giant web, I know it.

events.summary: The Selesnya high priests meet as the guild fades; Molander proposes an academy to keep the guild alive.
events.quote: Selesnya must go on with or without our parun , Mat'Selesnya.

events.summary: Troslon and Molander quarrel over rules and order, and the council breaks into factions.
events.quote: "I'll show you tangible," Troslon rumbled, balling up a massive fist.

events.summary: Suniel proposes binding the dryads to a tree so they can draw power to reach the Lattice.
Suniel binds the sisters to the roots of an oak; they enter the Lattice and reach each other's minds.
events.quote: Then Suniel's magic flowed into them.

events.summary: Mat'Selesnya speaks to Cim and tells her to raise an army to stop the ambitions of the rootless ones and the scheming dragon.
events.quote: And then, in a voice as clear as a crystal bell, Mat'Selesnya spoke.

events.summary: Mat'Selesnya warns that the sisters will bond with all the trees of Ravnica and can never return; Cim agrees.
events.quote: Cim looked at her sisters. "We understand, Great Mother."

events.summary: The roots absorb the three dryads into the oaks while Suniel watches helplessly.
events.quote: watch helplessly as the three sisters disappeared into the oaks.

events.summary: The three dryads appear grown from the World Tree in the great hall of Vitu-Ghazi as the new guildmaster, and Suniel realizes the Cim he knew is no more.
events.quote: Little did they know that they would gaze upon their new guildmaster for the first time.

relations.quote: They were an inseparable trio but far from identical.
looking at her other sister Ses

relations.note: She is a dryad of the Conclave.
relations.quote: a power existed within her that everyone in the Conclave could feel.

relations.note: She is the parun of the guild.
relations.quote: Selesnya must go on with or without our parun , Mat'Selesnya.

relations.note: He helps the dryads reach the Lattice.
relations.quote: If I connected you to a tree in this way, you could draw power from it
